title: Time to first token spikes at peak
summary: Diagnose a TTFT p99 regression at peak traffic.

choices.text: Add replicas, or autoscale on queue length and KV-cache usage rather than on GPU utilisation.
Increase the maximum batch size so more requests are admitted at once, since memory is the bottleneck.
Enable prefix caching for the shared system prompt, so each prefill does less work.
Apply admission control: cap queue length and return a fast "busy" error or route to another region instead of queueing for seconds.
Switch to a larger model, since bigger models generate faster.
